description_en: Retrieves temporary access credentials for a cloud account role (CloudAccountRole)
description_zh: 获取云角色（CloudAccountRole）的临时访问凭证
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi obtain-cloud-account-role-access-credential --authorization Bearer_xxxxxx --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --cloud-account-role-external-id acs:ram::xxx:role/role-test --region cn-hangzhou
name: ObtainCloudAccountRoleAccessCredential

parameters.help_en:
The authentication information. Format: Bearer ${access_token}. 
Enter the Access Token issued by IDaaS
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。 格式为：Bearer ${access_token}。 
请输入IDaaS签发的Access Token
parameters.name: authorization

parameters.help_en: The business identifier of the cloud account role
parameters.name: cloud_account_role_external_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the validity duration of the temporary security credentials (STS Token) for the cloud account role, in seconds. Valid values: 900 to 43200 (15 minutes to 12 hours).
Constraints:
The minimum value cannot be less than 900 seconds.
The maximum value is subject to the maximum session duration limit of the cloud provider role or service account. For example, the default maximum session limit for an AWS role is 3600 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
指定云角色临时安全凭证（STS Token）的有效期持续时间，单位为秒。取值范围：900 ~ 43200（15分钟 ~ 12小时）
约束条件：
最小值不得低于900秒
最大值受云厂商角色/服务账号的最大会话时间限制，比如AWS默认角色最大会话限制为3600s
parameters.name: duration_seconds
